name: Cymbal Wealth Regulatory Reporting
description: Provides Basel III capital adequacy (CRAR), liquidity coverage (LCR/NSFR), and NPA analysis for Cymbal Wealth's regulatory compliance. Backed by Redshift Serverless.

skills.name: Capital Adequacy (CRAR)
skills.description: Report CRAR (Capital to Risk-weighted Assets Ratio) vs RBI minimum of 9%

skills.name: Liquidity Coverage Ratios
skills.description: Report LCR and NSFR liquidity metrics

skills.name: NPA Summary
skills.description: Report Gross NPA %, Net NPA %, and provision coverage

skills.name: Basel III Summary
skills.description: Comprehensive Basel III report with Tier 1, Tier 2 capital breakdown and risk-weighted assets
